name: Procurement Strategy
notes: Landscape page. The title block prints Date, not Date Prepared. The eight Contract Type checkboxes print on one line; the Incentive or Award Fee table directly under them belongs to the Contract Type section and prints four blank rows. A text block directly before a table is that table's printed heading. Procurement Life Cycle prints six blank rows. The prose Table 2.34 says Delivery methods (with Professional services and Construction services sub-elements), Contract types and Procurement phases, where the blank form prints a single Delivery Method box, Contract Type and Procurement Life Cycle; the blank form wins. The prose table expands the contract-type abbreviations (FFP, Firm Fixed Price; FPIF, Fixed Price with Incentive Fee; FP-EPA, Fixed Price with Economic Price Adjustment; CPFF, Cost Plus Fixed Fee; CPIF, Cost Plus Incentive Fee; CPAF, Cost Plus Award Fee; T&M, Time and Materials), but the blank form prints only the abbreviations.
